title: Motivating Your Sales Team
overview: Sales motivation is not sustained by targets and incentives alone. This practical program equips sales leaders to understand individual performance drivers, create a fair and energizing work environment, and translate motivation into consistent selling behaviors and measurable results. Participants learn to diagnose disengagement, tailor recognition and coaching, design balanced incentives, lead through pressure and setbacks, and build accountability without undermining trust or customer-focused selling.
audience: Sales managers, supervisors, team leaders and branch or territory managers.
Business development and key account leaders responsible for sales performance.
Regional and area managers leading indoor, outdoor or hybrid sales teams.
Sales enablement professionals and aspiring sales leaders.
methodology: Facilitated discussions, sales-team motivation diagnostics, realistic management case studies, individual-driver mapping, coaching and recognition role plays, incentive-design workshops, KPI interpretation exercises, peer feedback, and development of a practical team motivation action plan.
competencies: Diagnosing individual and team motivation factors and barriers.
Adapting leadership, coaching, feedback and recognition approaches.
Setting meaningful goals and creating ownership of sales activity.
Designing equitable incentives and non-financial rewards.
Maintaining morale, resilience, accountability and ethical sales conduct.
Tracking engagement and performance indicators to improve team effectiveness.
objectives: Explain the relationship between motivation, sales behaviors, customer value and results.
Identify intrinsic and extrinsic motivators across different salesperson profiles.
Diagnose disengagement using observation, conversations and performance evidence.
Set clear, challenging and achievable goals with individual ownership.
Apply constructive coaching, feedback, recognition and development opportunities.
Assess incentive structures for fairness, unintended effects and sustainability.
Rebuild confidence after rejection, missed targets and organizational change.
Develop and monitor a practical sales-team motivation improvement plan.
